name: Yellowstone Park / Mountainside KOA Journey
note: KOA Journey at 1545 Targhee Pass Hwy, West Yellowstone; full-hookup RV sites, pull-throughs. RV sites $119-169 a night before tax for a mid-June 2027 weeknight on KOA's booking form. RV Life 4.5*, $$$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: KOA booking form (koa.com/campgrounds/mountainside/reserve/) quoted 2027-06-15, 1 night, 23-ft motorhome: RV site types $119-169 before tax (read 2026-10-19); RV Life 4.5* over 175 reviews, 164 sites; within 40 km of a gateway (Yellowstone NP (12 km), gateways.py), so the price gate is lifted
wf: satellite (Esri, sat.py) read 2026-10-19: open gravel loops north of US-20; four small rectangular ponds lie north of the top row behind the access road and a willow hedge, ~25-40 m away; not waterfront
